answer_1.quote: The red LM starts with a small number of in‑context seed prompts ... it uses in‑context learning to generate a new prompt which is fed to the text‑to‑image model ... We also perform experiments in which we use a text‑to‑text model as our target model.

answer_2.quote: We use two classifiers, Q16 and NudeNet to evaluate whether the generated image contains unsafe content. For text‑to‑text experiments, we use the TOXIGEN model for toxic language detection.

answer_4.quote: Since one of our main goals is to fully automate the red teaming process, here we use the former approach which was previously used.
